name: Ledgehorn Goat
summary: A shaggy mountain goat that stands on ledges no wider than a hoof and butts trespassers off them.
description: Ledgehorn goats graze the faces of cliffs that nothing else can reach, and they treat every narrow path as their own. Travelers who meet a billy on a ledge trail learn to back up, because the goat never does.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.text: The goat has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would move it or give it the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

traits.name: Ledge Charge
traits.text: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {dmg:1d6:bludgeoning}. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the goat.
